title: Freestanding 4 Pivoting Swing Arm Towel Stand 49-Inch Solid Brass | Glokzin Teal | Assorted Free Standing Accessories | Allied Brass
description:
Need more towel space without putting holes in tile? This freestanding towel stand (also called a towel rack or towel holder) adds flexible, floor-standing towel storage for the bathroom in Glokzin Teal, which delivers rich, jewel-toned sophistication, adding artistic depth and a designer touch to modern bathrooms. Four pivoting swing arms rotate so you can separate bath towels and keep them easy to grab.

Highlights:
- Glokzin Teal transforms this essential into a conversation piece
- Choose from 28 designer finishes to match the rest of your bathroom
- Stable footprint: large, weighted base is designed to help prevent tipping
- Built to last: solid brass construction resists rust and corrosion
- Coordinate your bath hardware: designed to match the Assorted Free Standing Accessories collection and other transitional bathroom hardware

Specs & Details:
- Product type: Bath towel stand / towel rail / towel rack / towel holder (freestanding)
- Number of arms: 4 swing arms, pivoting
- Material: Solid brass (brass construction)
- Dimensions (L x H x W): 12 in. x 49 in. x 9.25 in.
- Assembly: Some assembly required
Multiple designer finish options available
- Warranty: Limited lifetime warranty
- Assembled in the USA
